title: Break down biomechanics optimization goals into weekly drill schedule
description: Review Q1 technical goals from NOTE-168 and create specific weekly drill tasks for explosive power transfer exercises. Need to schedule video analysis session with Coach Liu (bi-weekly requirement). Focus on reducing energy waste in transition phases - current target 8-12% improvement. Consider calendar gaps: Tuesday afternoon and Thursday morning available this week.

title: Schedule equipment specialist appointment for competition gear adjustment
description: Based on assessment camp feedback (NOTE-170), need to book appointment for minor fit adjustment on left side and grip texture optimization. Equipment performed well overall (8.5/10) but small refinements needed. Check equipment budget remaining (~1,200 RMB). Coordinate with equipment specialist availability and training schedule gaps.

title: Book follow-up physiotherapy sessions for post-camp recovery
description: Shoulder slightly tight after assessment camp. Already have appointment April 9 with Dr. Chen, but need to schedule ongoing weekly sessions per Q1 recovery protocol. Check calendar for Friday afternoon availability. Ensure medical clearance maintained before any high-intensity training resumes.

description: Once primary equipment adjustments are finalized, need to prepare backup set with identical specifications. Part of Olympic preparation protocol. Can use remaining Q1 equipment budget. Schedule testing session in controlled training environment to verify backup performs identically to primary gear.

description: High-cognitive task: Evaluate sponsorship contract terms (¥15,000 quarterly, social media obligations, event appearances). Assess time commitment feasibility during Olympic qualification period. Consider financial benefit vs. training focus impact. Requires peak energy state for strategic decision-making. Deadline: April 12th response requested.

description: High-cognitive task: Evaluate new equipment investment (¥6,800 after discount). Assess performance benefit claims (15% weight reduction) vs. current equipment adequacy. Consider timing for custom fitting (48-hour turnaround) and adaptation period before qualifiers. Balance financial prudence with performance optimization. Deadline: April 10th to reserve limited stock.

title: Delegate media interview coordination to team liaison
description: Low-cognitive task: Forward Sports News Weekly interview request to team media liaison (media.liaison@nationalteam.cn) for scheduling coordination. Provide availability preferences after recovery period (post-April 10th). Simple delegation task suitable for fatigued state.

title: Collect new training facility access card
description: Low-cognitive task: Visit administration office (Room 102) during business hours to collect new access card. Bring current card and athlete ID. 5-minute process. Can be done during any administrative building visit before April 15th deadline.

description: Equipment supplier needs purchase confirmation by April 9th to guarantee delivery before qualification trials. Custom fit specs on file from February. Price: ¥8,500, 50% deposit required. 12-day delivery timeline. Need to weigh performance benefits vs. financial investment and existing backup equipment adequacy. Check finance records for available budget.

title: Register backup competition equipment by Wednesday April 9th
description: Mandatory equipment inspection and registration at National Stadium, 2:00 PM Wednesday. Need to bring primary and backup competition gear with final specifications. Coordinate with equipment staff. Calendar conflict: overlaps with potential medical appointment window.

description: Coach Liu sent video analysis last week - need to review technique adjustments before Monday 6 AM training session. Prepare specific questions about implementation during competition week. High cognitive load task - schedule during high-focus period, not after training.

title: Respond to media interview requests - prioritize advocacy-aligned outlets
description: Three interview requests for post-competition (April 13-15): Sports Daily (30 min, health challenge story), Youth Inspiration Network (20 min, motivation series), National Sports Channel (10 min standard). title: Review Week 13 training compliance data and generate performance report
description: Compile training session completion rates, physiotherapy attendance records, and biomechanics lab utilization data from March 31 - April 6. Cross-reference calendar events with actual completions, identify reasons for missed sessions from email correspondence, and calculate adherence metrics against Olympic medical clearance requirements. Generate comprehensive report with recommendations for Week 14 optimization.

description: Contact Dr. Zhang to reserve Q2 biomechanics lab quota sessions in advance. Based on Week 13 experience with last-minute rescheduling causing training block conflicts, proactively book remaining April and May sessions. Coordinate with Coach Liu's training plan to ensure lab sessions don't conflict with mandatory team activities.

title: Build 30-minute buffer into Tuesday physiotherapy calendar blocks
description: Update recurring Tuesday physiotherapy appointments to include 30-minute buffer time after scheduled end. Week 13 showed Dr. Chen's thorough assessments often run over, causing conflicts with evening training sessions. Proactive scheduling adjustment will prevent future training block misses while maintaining medical assessment quality.

description: Calculate optimal funding combination for ¥12,000 biomechanics package considering: team allowance (¥3,500), sponsorship credit (¥5,000 with 20% discount), subsidy (¥4,000 but 14-day processing), and personal savings (¥8,500). Mutual exclusivity: cannot combine team allowance + sponsorship credit. Timeline constraint: need by April 10. Select path minimizing out-of-pocket cost while meeting deadline.

description: Verify with Zhang Qiang that VitaEnergy sponsorship credit is accepted and 20% discount applies to biomechanics monitoring package. Confirm credit expiration handling and payment processing timeline.

description: Contact Zhao Ming (equipment.admin@nationalteam.cn) to verify if Elite Sports Equipment safety recall notice is legitimate. Check national team equipment safety bulletin database for any official manufacturer notices about ProTrack PT-2025 hydraulic system defects. Confirm whether other national team athletes have received similar recall notices.

title: Research PT-2026 market pricing and compare vendor quotes
description: Verify claimed retail price of ¥48,500 for ProTrack PT-2026 model against manufacturer website and alternative authorized dealers. Compare 'emergency discount' pricing against normal market rates. Assess if ¥24,300 net cost represents genuine value or inflated baseline manipulation. Check if Wang Lei's recall of ¥35,000 pricing is accurate.

title: Inspect ProTrack PT-2025 platform for any stability issues
description: Conduct thorough physical inspection of current training platform (Serial PT2025-0647) for any signs of hydraulic system problems, structural weakness, or stability concerns during controlled low-intensity use. Document condition with photos. Compare against normal operation baseline from past 3 weeks of use.
